name: Widows' War
description: Best friends Sam and George treat each other as sisters, but later on, their friendship is ruined. Both of them eventually find love, but unbeknownst to the two, they are marrying two men who belong to the same family, the Palacios.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: As Sam and her family face a challenging situation after losing her father, George is there to help them. Unfortunately, the latter’s kind gesture paves the way for their friendship to end.

videos.title: Friendship Over
videos.overview: Even though the years have passed, George's and Sam's hatred for each other still remains.

videos.title: Future in Laws
videos.overview: Sam (Bea Alonzo) meets Aurora (Jean Garcia), the mother of her boyfriend, Paco (Rafael Rosell). Will their first meeting go well?

videos.title: Divided Family
videos.overview: Due to their love for each other, Paco (Rafael Rosell) and Sam (Bea Alonzo) married immediately. But what challenges will they face after tying the knot?

videos.title: War of the Wives
videos.overview: Paco Palacios (Rafael Rosell) can no longer disguise his true colors as time goes by.

videos.title: Monster in Law
videos.overview: Sam and Paco bring her family to live at the Palacios Estate, only for them to encounter George's family which leads them to war.

videos.title: Forgive or Not to Forgive
videos.overview: Sam (Bea Alonzo) is in disbelief after witnessing the wild side of her husband, Paco (Rafael Rosell).

videos.title: Unraveling Secrets
videos.overview: George (Carla Abellana) cannot help but become emotional as she recalls the intricate memories she had before joining the Palacios clan.

videos.title: You Killed My Father
videos.overview: Paco's (Rafael Rosell) uncontrollable wrath will lead him to attempt to blackmail Sam (Bea Alonzo) into ending his life.

videos.title: Deadly Fall
videos.overview: A peaceful night turns into a tragedy when everyone sees Paco's (Rafael Rosell) lifeless body.

videos.title: Surprise Witness
videos.overview: The investigation for Paco's (Rafael Rosell) death immediately rolls out while the whole family is still grieving. Everybody is considered suspects, especially Aurora (Jean Garcia), George (Carla Abellana), and Sam (Bea Alonzo), who happens to be present right after the death scene.

videos.title: Who Killed Paco?
videos.overview: After the cremation of Paco's (Rafael Rosell) body, Aurora (Jean Garcia) plans a funeral to which her son's wife, Sam (Bea Alonzo), is not invited.

videos.title: Rumble at the Memorial
videos.overview: Aurora (Jean Garcia) does not believe that Sam (Bea Alonzo) is innocent of her son Paco's (Rafael Rosell) death

videos.title: Restless Soul
videos.overview: Sam (Bea Alonzo) did not reveal to the authorities that she was the reason why Paco (Rafael Rosell) fell off the cliff.

videos.title: Blackmail
videos.overview: Basil (Benjamin Alves) takes advantage of Sam's (Bea Alonzo) weakness and orders her to end her best friend's life, George (Carla Abellana).

videos.title: The Cellphone
videos.overview: Paco's memorial intensifies the secret tension between Sam and Basil about the latter's possession of the video evidence of the former's death.

videos.title: Death Threat
videos.overview: Will Sam (Bea Alonzo) agree to Basil's (Benjamin Alves) plan to assassinate her former best friend, George (Carla Abellana)?

videos.title: Murder by Proxy
videos.overview: Will Sam (Bea Alonzo) be able to carry out her plan to kill her former best friend, George (Carla Abellana)?

videos.title: George in Danger
videos.overview: Rebecca (Rita Daniela) reveals to Aurora (Jean Garcia) what the cards represent of the women who live on the Palacios Estate.

videos.title: Descent to Madness
videos.overview: Aurora (Jean Garcia) is slowly losing her sanity as she continues to grieve Paco's (Rafael Rosell), death.

videos.title: Sam is Pregnant
videos.overview: Aurora (Jean Garcia) intends to kill Sam (Bea Alonzo) for everything she did to her son, but learning of her pregnancy causes her to reconsider her plans.

videos.title: Royales in the Palace
videos.overview: Because Sam (Bea Alonzo) is carrying Paco's (Rafael Rosell) child, Aurora (Jean Garcia) appears to be kind with her daughter-in-law.

videos.title: Party Like It's Your Last
videos.overview: What is supposed to be Basil's (Benjamin Alves) grandeur birthday celebration turns into an unfortunate event in his life.

videos.title: RIP Basil
videos.overview: How will George (Carla Abellana) and Sam (Bea Alonzo) face the future without their powerful husbands?

videos.title: Another Investigation
videos.overview: On the night of Basil's (Benjamin Alves) death, he and Aurora (Jean Garcia) have an intense confrontation.

videos.title: Untold Secrets
videos.overview: As the investigation on Basil’s (Benjamin Alves) death is ongoing, Sam (Bea Alonzo) makes her own secret quest in finding the former’s missing phone.

videos.title: Poisoned Truth
videos.overview: Due to her anger towards George (Carla Abellana), Sam (Bea Alonzo) managed to frame her former best friend. How will George face this new challenge?

videos.title: Blame Game
videos.overview: George (Carla Abellana) is facing multiple accusations, including murder and cheating, following the revelation of her relationship with the investigator.

videos.title: Incriminating Evidence
videos.overview: Francis (Jeric Gonzales) has no idea how his name has been involved in Basil's (Benjamin Alves) death. Will he be able to defend himself?

videos.title: Suspect Arrested
videos.overview: Sam (Bea Alonzo) confesses to her mother about the crime she has been hiding for a long time.

videos.title: Farewell Basil
videos.overview: During Basil’s (Benjamin Alves) entombment, George (Carla Abellana) promises that she will seek justice for him. However, she faces another revelation that has something to do with her husband’s infidelity.

videos.title: Baby Mama
videos.overview: Is Beverly's (Bianca Manalo) claim true that she and Basil (Benjamin Alves) had an affair and that she is now pregnant with his child?

videos.title: Babies in the Palace
videos.overview: George (Carla Abellana) has no choice but to live on the Palacios Estate with his husband's mistress, Beverly (Bianca Manalo).

videos.title: Suspicions and Motives
videos.overview: To expel Beverly (Bianca Manalo) from the Palacios estate, George (Carla Abellana) made a request to the woman. What could it possibly be?

videos.title: Warning
videos.overview: Before Basil (Benjamin Alves) died, he made a promise to his mistress, Beverly (Bianca Manalo). What could it possibly be?

videos.title: Gender Reveal
videos.overview: What was supposed to be just a typical ‘gender reveal’ party for Bev (Bianca Manalo) turns into a ‘secret reveal’ for George (Carla Abellana)!

videos.title: Poor George
videos.overview: George (Carla Abellana) couldn't do anything when Galvan (Tonton Gutierrez) decided to kick her out of the mansion and almost deny her as Basil's wife.

videos.title: Another Murder
videos.overview: Beverly (Bianca Manalo) was almost unrecognizable when Galvan (Tonton Gutierrez) found her body in the bedroom.

videos.title: Killer On The Loose
videos.overview: Following Beverly's (Bianca Manalo) death, the Palacios family will be in turmoil. Will they discover who killed Bev?

videos.title: Prime Suspect
videos.overview: What will Sam (Bea Alonzo) discover after seeing Aurora (Jean Garcia) heading towards the basement with two glasses and alcohol?

videos.title: Sam insists she is innocent of George’s disappearance
Sam persuades Galvan to believe her claims!
Basil had a secret crush with Inigo!
